item.title: About
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Building Growth. Connecting Futures.

Bridging the gap between potential and performance through mentorship, networking, and sustainable action.

Transform Lives with Your Support! Donate Now Ready to Transform Your Future? Join Now

welcome to

Jenga365

More Than A Game: The Jenga365 Initiative

Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to transcend the traditional boundaries of sport. We exist to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by leveraging the discipline and community of rugby as a vehicle for holistic growth.

We recognize that an athlete’s journey involves more than just physical performance. That is why we bridge the gap between potential (youth) and performance (career and life) through a tripartite model:

  • Mentorship Programs (Human Capital): Connecting ambitious talent with seasoned professionals to build mental resilience and identity.

  • Networking Clinics (Social Capital): bridging the skills gap through financial literacy, career readiness, and professional access.

  • Impact Activities (Sustainability): Operationalizing "Rugby for Change" to drive environmental stewardship and climate action directly through the rugby calendar.

We are not just building players; we are building the "Total Athlete", addressing the Mind, Body, Pocket, and Planet.

Our Mission

To bridge the gap between potential and performance by keeping youth in the rugby community and extensive societies constructive 365 days a year. Jenga365 aims to create sustainable environments and enhance community welfare through a tripartite approach: specialized mentorship programs, career-focused networking clinics, and community-driven impact activities.

Our Foundation

Founded on the principle that an athlete's value extends far beyond the pitch, Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to build the "Total Athlete". We aim to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by bridging the gap between potential and performance. Whether you are an aspiring player seeking career readiness, a professional looking to give back, or an enthusiast passionate about the Green Game, Jenga365 provides the mentorship, networking, and impact activities needed to ensure no one navigates their journey alone.

Our Approach

We have evolved beyond simple matching. Jenga365 operates on a tripartite model designed to build the "Total Athlete".

  • Mentorship Programs: Building Human Capital through psycho-social support and career guidance.

  • Networking Clinics: Building Social Capital through financial literacy and professional access.

  • Impact Activities: Driving Sustainability through "The Green Game" and community stewardship.

This structured approach ensures that every connection drives not just personal success, but tangible community welfare.

Join the Movement

Join us today and be part of a movement that transforms lives, one mentorship at a time. Together, we’re building brighter futures for aspiring athletes and professionals across the globe.

Our Mission

To empower the next generation by providing accessible mentorship, fostering valuable networks, and driving tangible community impact. We believe that whether on the rugby pitch or in the boardroom, no one should have to navigate their journey alone.

Our Foundation

Founded on the principle that mentorship is the cornerstone of achievement, Jenga365 creates meaningful connections between mentees seeking direction and mentors eager to share their expertise. Whether you’re an aspiring rugby player aiming to excel on the field, a professional navigating a career transition, or a mentor ready to give back, Jenga365 is your platform to grow, learn, and thrive.

Our Approach

Our carefully designed matching system ensures that mentors and mentees are paired based on shared goals, expertise, and passions, fostering impactful relationships that drive personal and professional development. From career guidance to athletic training, we prioritize authenticity, community, and sustainability in everything we do.

Join the Movement

Join us today and be part of a movement that transforms lives, one mentorship at a time. Together, we’re building brighter futures for aspiring athletes and professionals across the globe.

Transform Lives with Your Support! Donate Now Sign Up As A Mentor Sign Up As A Mentee

Our history

Years of Journey

History

The Genesis

Every structure needs a cornerstone. For Jenga365, that stone was laid in October 2024. We started with a singular, burning observation: there was a disconnect between talent and opportunity. We saw young people, particularly those in the rugby fraternity, who possessed immense potential but lacked the professional networks and mentorship guidance to navigate their futures. Our mandate back then was simple yet critical: bridge the gap. We launched as a platform dedicated solely to solving the issues of networking and mentorship, helping young talent find their footing.

1st October 2024

The Strategic Pivot

However, as we executed our initial pilots, we realized that true development requires more than just advice; it requires a holistic ecosystem. In 2025, we made a bold decision. We took a strategic break. We didn't just pause; we analyzed. relying heavily on Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) frameworks, we scrutinized every activity held since our inception. The data told us that while mentorship was vital, our community needed tangible support to thrive. We re-strategized. We expanded our scope: We moved beyond just conversation to include Impact Activities; initiatives like school drives and sports clinics that address immediate needs. We went digital: We launched an active, centralized website to streamline the matching process. We got holistic: We revamped our social media to reflect the full 360-degree view of an athlete’s life; education, sport, career, and community.

21st October 2024

The Acceleration

Today, in 2026, the foundation is settled, and the building has begun in earnest. We represent a new era of aggressive growth. We are no longer just "testing the waters." We are operating with set quarterly goals, driven by rigorous M&E to ensure that every resource deployed maximizes impact for the beneficiaries. But "Jenga" means "to build," and no great structure is built alone. As we scale our mentorship programs and deepen our community impact, we are actively opening our doors for collaboration. We are looking for like-minded organizations, corporate partners, and rugby clubs to join us. Our goal is not just to succeed as an organization, but to build each other up. Together, we can ensure that every young person we touch gets the start they deserve. Let’s Build. Let’s Connect. Let’s Impact.

21 June 2025-

NGO Registration

Registration as an NGO is ongoing, but the full operations are ongoing, and updates shared on the website and our socials.

  • Networking Clinics (Social Capital):<\/b> bridging the skills gap through financial literacy, career readiness, and professional access.<\/p><\/li>

  • Impact Activities (Sustainability):<\/b> Operationalizing \"Rugby for Change\" to drive environmental stewardship and climate action directly through the rugby calendar.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

welcome to

Jenga365

More Than A Game: The Jenga365 Initiative

Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to transcend the traditional boundaries of sport. We exist to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by leveraging the discipline and community of rugby as a vehicle for holistic growth.

We recognize that an athlete’s journey involves more than just physical performance. That is why we bridge the gap between potential (youth) and performance (career and life) through a tripartite model:

  • Mentorship Programs (Human Capital): Connecting ambitious talent with seasoned professionals to build mental resilience and identity.

  • Networking Clinics (Social Capital): bridging the skills gap through financial literacy, career readiness, and professional access.

  • Impact Activities (Sustainability): Operationalizing "Rugby for Change" to drive environmental stewardship and climate action directly through the rugby calendar.

We are not just building players; we are building the "Total Athlete", addressing the Mind, Body, Pocket, and Planet.

Our Mission

To bridge the gap between potential and performance by keeping youth in the rugby community and extensive societies constructive 365 days a year. Jenga365 aims to create sustainable environments and enhance community welfare through a tripartite approach: specialized mentorship programs, career-focused networking clinics, and community-driven impact activities.

Our Foundation

Founded on the principle that an athlete's value extends far beyond the pitch, Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to build the "Total Athlete". We aim to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by bridging the gap between potential and performance. Whether you are an aspiring player seeking career readiness, a professional looking to give back, or an enthusiast passionate about the Green Game, Jenga365 provides the mentorship, networking, and impact activities needed to ensure no one navigates their journey alone.

Our Approach

We have evolved beyond simple matching. Jenga365 operates on a tripartite model designed to build the "Total Athlete".

  • Mentorship Programs: Building Human Capital through psycho-social support and career guidance.

  • Networking Clinics: Building Social Capital through financial literacy and professional access.

  • Impact Activities: Driving Sustainability through "The Green Game" and community stewardship.

This structured approach ensures that every connection drives not just personal success, but tangible community welfare.

Join the Movement

Join us today and be part of a movement that transforms lives, one mentorship at a time. Together, we’re building brighter futures for aspiring athletes and professionals across the globe.

Our Mission

To empower the next generation by providing accessible mentorship, fostering valuable networks, and driving tangible community impact. We believe that whether on the rugby pitch or in the boardroom, no one should have to navigate their journey alone.

Our Foundation

Founded on the principle that mentorship is the cornerstone of achievement, Jenga365 creates meaningful connections between mentees seeking direction and mentors eager to share their expertise. Whether you’re an aspiring rugby player aiming to excel on the field, a professional navigating a career transition, or a mentor ready to give back, Jenga365 is your platform to grow, learn, and thrive.

Our Approach

Our carefully designed matching system ensures that mentors and mentees are paired based on shared goals, expertise, and passions, fostering impactful relationships that drive personal and professional development. From career guidance to athletic training, we prioritize authenticity, community, and sustainability in everything we do.

Join the Movement

Join us today and be part of a movement that transforms lives, one mentorship at a time. Together, we’re building brighter futures for aspiring athletes and professionals across the globe.

Our history

Years of Journey

History

The Genesis

Every structure needs a cornerstone. For Jenga365, that stone was laid in October 2024. We started with a singular, burning observation: there was a disconnect between talent and opportunity. We saw young people, particularly those in the rugby fraternity, who possessed immense potential but lacked the professional networks and mentorship guidance to navigate their futures. Our mandate back then was simple yet critical: bridge the gap. We launched as a platform dedicated solely to solving the issues of networking and mentorship, helping young talent find their footing.

1st October 2024

The Strategic Pivot

However, as we executed our initial pilots, we realized that true development requires more than just advice; it requires a holistic ecosystem. In 2025, we made a bold decision. We took a strategic break. We didn't just pause; we analyzed. relying heavily on Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) frameworks, we scrutinized every activity held since our inception. The data told us that while mentorship was vital, our community needed tangible support to thrive. We re-strategized. We expanded our scope: We moved beyond just conversation to include Impact Activities; initiatives like school drives and sports clinics that address immediate needs. We went digital: We launched an active, centralized website to streamline the matching process. We got holistic: We revamped our social media to reflect the full 360-degree view of an athlete’s life; education, sport, career, and community.

21st October 2024

The Acceleration

Today, in 2026, the foundation is settled, and the building has begun in earnest. We represent a new era of aggressive growth. We are no longer just "testing the waters." We are operating with set quarterly goals, driven by rigorous M&E to ensure that every resource deployed maximizes impact for the beneficiaries. But "Jenga" means "to build," and no great structure is built alone. As we scale our mentorship programs and deepen our community impact, we are actively opening our doors for collaboration. We are looking for like-minded organizations, corporate partners, and rugby clubs to join us. Our goal is not just to succeed as an organization, but to build each other up. Together, we can ensure that every young person we touch gets the start they deserve. Let’s Build. Let’s Connect. Let’s Impact.

21 June 2025-

NGO Registration

Registration as an NGO is ongoing, but the full operations are ongoing, and updates shared on the website and our socials.

21st September 2025

item.title: Home
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Building Growth. Connecting Futures.

The premier mentorship and networking platform for the rugby community and beyond. In 2026, we are focused on Consistency, Impact, and the Holistic Development of every athlete.

2026: A Year of Consistency & Growth We are moving beyond potential to performance. After laying our foundation, Jenga365 is now fully operational, connecting ambitious mentees with experienced professionals. Whether you are on the pitch or in the boardroom, our mission is to ensure no one has to navigate their journey alone.

Sign up as mentor Sign up as mentee

Real Impact in Real Time

1. Education First: We believe that academic success is just as vital as athletic performance. At Jenga365, we prioritise the holistic development of our athletes by advocating for and facilitating access to the necessary resources they need to thrive in the classroom. We are committed to ensuring that for every step taken on the pitch, an equal stride is made in their education. 

2. Mentorship in Action: We bridge the gap between potential and experience. By connecting aspiring talent with seasoned veterans and professionals, we foster an environment of organic skills transfer, ensuring that guidance received on the pitch seamlessly translates into leadership, discipline, and resilience off it. 

3. The Green Game: We are committed to environmental stewardship, integrating tree planting and clean-ups into our rugby calendar.

Why Choose Jenga365?

1. Holistic Growth: We don't just build players; we build people. Our mentorship covers career, education, and mental well-being.

2. Community Rooted: Born from the rugby values of teamwork, discipline, and respect.

3. Safe & Structured: A verified platform ensuring safe, productive connections for youth and professionals alike.

Personal guidance on your journey

Mentors with experience in your field provide tailored advice

Safety & Clarity

New opportunities through valuable connections

Networking features connect you with the right people

Belonging & Motivation

Easy entry into mentoring

Clear profiles and a matching system save time finding the right fit

Efficiency & Focus

Our programs

Explore our dedicated programs designed to foster growth and success for both mentors and mentees.

Mentor Program

Share your expertise, guide the next generation, and make a lasting impact. Our platform provides tools to connect with motivated mentees in your field.

Learn More

Mentee Program

Accelerate your career or athletic journey with personalized guidance from experienced professionals. Find the perfect mentor to help you navigate your challenges.

Learn More

Building Trust through authority

Join a growing community of success stories

Years of Experience
Mentees & Mentors Connected
Satisfaction Rate

Your Journey Starts Here

 Three simple steps to transformation

Sign Up

Create your free profile in minutes

Learn more

Get Matched

Tell us what you're looking for and find your perfect match

Learn more

Achieve Goals

Reach your professional goals with expert guidance

Learn more

Success Stories

With her mentor's guidance, Sarah transitioned from a junior role to a leadership position.

Sarah's Journey to Success Financial Analyst

Mark's mentor helped him navigate the competitive tech industry, leading to a significant career advancement.

Mark's Breakthrough in Tech Data Analyst

Emily's mentor provided the support and resources she needed to pivot her career and achieve her professional aspirations.

Emily's Career Transformation UI/UX Designer Sign up as mentee Sign up as mentor

Frequently Asked Questions

 Everything you need to know

Will this be expensive?

Mentoring is absolutely free—start learning, growing, and connecting at zero cost. At Jenga365, we believe in accessible mentorship for everyone, so there are no fees for joining as a mentor or mentee, participating in our programs, or accessing our resources.

Will the mentor really be a good fit?

Our matching process has a 95% success rate, using your profile details (like city and interests) to pair you with a mentor who aligns with your goals. Plus, you have the flexibility to switch mentors if needed—we’re committed to finding your perfect match.

Do I have enough time?

Mentoring happens on your schedule. With flexible online meetings and adaptable scheduling, you can fit mentoring into even the busiest lifestyle. Sessions can be as short as 30 minutes, and you can coordinate directly with your mentor via our platform.

How do I register for Jenga365?

Registration is simple! Visit our homepage or registration page, choose to join as a Mentor or Mentee, and fill out the form with your username, email, city, and optional profile picture. After agreeing to our Privacy Policy, you’ll be redirected to log in and start exploring.

Can I update my profile picture or details later?

Yes! You can update your profile details, including your profile picture and city, by visiting your profile page. Use the edit profile feature to keep your information current and ensure the best mentor-mentee matches.

How does frontend posting work?

Registered users can submit articles or mentorship stories on our articles page. After logging in, use the submission form to share your experiences, tag them with hashtags like #RugbyKE or #MentorshipMatters, and manage your posts from your profile dashboard. Your profile picture will appear alongside your published articles.

Is my personal information safe?

Absolutely. We prioritize your privacy and comply with GDPR. Your username, email, city, and optional profile picture are securely stored and only used to enhance your mentorship experience. Review our Privacy Policy for details on data handling, reCAPTCHA, and AddToAny Share Buttons.

Can I participate in Rugby Mentorship Clinics or the Jenga365 Mentorship Summit 2025?

Yes! Registered users can join our Rugby Mentorship Clinics and the Jenga365 Mentorship Summit 2025. Check your profile dashboard for event updates and registration links, or visit our community pages for more information.

How can I contribute to community initiatives like Nondescripts RFC or Nairobi Dam restoration?

Get involved by visiting our Social Responsibility page or making a donation. Share your involvement on our articles page with hashtags like #RugbyKE to inspire others. Your profile picture and stories will help amplify these initiatives.

What if I encounter technical issues?

Contact our support team at info@jenga365.com. Whether it’s a registration, profile display, or posting issue, we’ll assist promptly to ensure a seamless experience.

Building Growth. Connecting Futures.

The premier mentorship and networking platform for the rugby community and beyond. In 2026, we are focused on Consistency, Impact, and the Holistic Development of every athlete.

2026: A Year of Consistency & Growth We are moving beyond potential to performance. After laying our foundation, Jenga365 is now fully operational, connecting ambitious mentees with experienced professionals. Whether you are on the pitch or in the boardroom, our mission is to ensure no one has to navigate their journey alone.

Sign up as mentor
Sign up as mentee

Real Impact in Real Time

1. Education First: We believe that academic success is just as vital as athletic performance. At Jenga365, we prioritise the holistic development of our athletes by advocating for and facilitating access to the necessary resources they need to thrive in the classroom. We are committed to ensuring that for every step taken on the pitch, an equal stride is made in their education. 

2. Mentorship in Action: We bridge the gap between potential and experience. By connecting aspiring talent with seasoned veterans and professionals, we foster an environment of organic skills transfer, ensuring that guidance received on the pitch seamlessly translates into leadership, discipline, and resilience off it. 

3. The Green Game: We are committed to environmental stewardship, integrating tree planting and clean-ups into our rugby calendar.

Why Choose Jenga365?

1. Holistic Growth: We don't just build players; we build people. Our mentorship covers career, education, and mental well-being.

2. Community Rooted: Born from the rugby values of teamwork, discipline, and respect.

3. Safe & Structured: A verified platform ensuring safe, productive connections for youth and professionals alike.

Personal guidance on your journey

Mentors with experience in your field provide tailored advice

Safety & Clarity

New opportunities through valuable connections

Networking features connect you with the right people

Belonging & Motivation

Easy entry into mentoring

Clear profiles and a matching system save time finding the right fit

Efficiency & Focus

Our programs

Explore our dedicated programs designed to foster growth and success for both mentors and mentees.

Mentor Program

Share your expertise, guide the next generation, and make a lasting impact. Our platform provides tools to connect with motivated mentees in your field.

Learn More

Mentee Program

Accelerate your career or athletic journey with personalized guidance from experienced professionals. Find the perfect mentor to help you navigate your challenges.

Learn More

Building Trust through authority

Join a growing community of success stories

item.title: Webinar
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Jenga365 Webinars

Ignite Your Potential, Multiply Our Impact

Welcome to the digital campfire of the Jenga365 community. Our webinars are more than just online meetings; they are the heartbeat of our mentorship ecosystem. Here, we dissolve the barriers between "aspiring" and "achieved," creating a direct line of knowledge transfer from industry leaders and rugby legends to the next generation of changemakers.

Why These Sessions Matter

1. Knowledge is the New Currency: In a world that moves fast, access to the right information at the right time changes everything. Our sessions cut through the noise, delivering hard-won wisdom on career navigation, mental resilience, and elite sports performance directly to your screen. When you show up, you aren't just listening, you are equipping yourself with the tools to build a life of purpose.

2. The Power of Numbers: The Jenga Multiplier Effect: You might think you are just one attendee, but in the Jenga365 ecosystem, your presence is power.

  • 10 Attendees spark a conversation.

  • 50 Attendees build a network.

  • 100+ Attendees create a movement.

Every person who joins our webinars strengthens the signal. A large turnout attracts higher-profile speakers, unlocks bigger partnership opportunities for our community, and creates a massive, searchable repository of diverse questions and insights. By showing up, you aren't just learning for yourself; you are validating the platform that will support thousands of others coming after you.

3. From Passive Listening to Active Building: These aren't lectures; they are blueprints. Whether we are dissecting a rugby strategy or a boardroom tactic, the goal is always application. We discuss real hurdles, share actionable strategies, and foster the kind of honest dialogue that only happens when a community trusts each other.

Jenga365 Webinars

Ignite Your Potential, Multiply Our Impact

Welcome to the digital campfire of the Jenga365 community. Our webinars are more than just online meetings; they are the heartbeat of our mentorship ecosystem. Here, we dissolve the barriers between "aspiring" and "achieved," creating a direct line of knowledge transfer from industry leaders and rugby legends to the next generation of changemakers.

Why These Sessions Matter

1. Knowledge is the New Currency: In a world that moves fast, access to the right information at the right time changes everything. Our sessions cut through the noise, delivering hard-won wisdom on career navigation, mental resilience, and elite sports performance directly to your screen. When you show up, you aren't just listening, you are equipping yourself with the tools to build a life of purpose.

2. The Power of Numbers: The Jenga Multiplier Effect: You might think you are just one attendee, but in the Jenga365 ecosystem, your presence is power.

  • 10 Attendees spark a conversation.

  • 50 Attendees build a network.

  • 100+ Attendees create a movement.

Every person who joins our webinars strengthens the signal. A large turnout attracts higher-profile speakers, unlocks bigger partnership opportunities for our community, and creates a massive, searchable repository of diverse questions and insights. By showing up, you aren't just learning for yourself; you are validating the platform that will support thousands of others coming after you.

3. From Passive Listening to Active Building: These aren't lectures; they are blueprints. Whether we are dissecting a rugby strategy or a boardroom tactic, the goal is always application. We discuss real hurdles, share actionable strategies, and foster the kind of honest dialogue that only happens when a community trusts each other.

item.title: Environmental
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Environmental Impacts

We recognize that a thriving game needs a thriving planet. At Jenga365, we are committed to "The Green Game", an initiative ensuring that our passion for rugby contributes to the preservation of our environment. By aligning our efforts with SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 15 (Life on Land), we aim to cultivate a generation of athletes who are as protective of their environment as they are of their teammates.

Welfare

Get Involved

Join us in safeguarding the delicate balance of our ecosystem, ensuring that nature thrives alongside our communities. By coming on board, you help us build a legacy of compassion and stewardship that protects our planet for generations to come.

1. Reforestation & Afforestation

Contributing to SDG 13: Climate Action & SDG 15: Life on Land

We observed that the very landscapes we play on and live in are increasingly threatened by deforestation and loss of green cover, posing a long-term risk to our communities' health. Our goal is to actively combat this by restoring green spaces and reducing our carbon footprint, ensuring a healthier environment for future generations of athletes. To achieve sustainable and scalable impact, we are moving beyond sporadic planting days to establishing long-term partnerships with environmental organizations and local authorities; this allows us to integrate tree planting into our regular sporting calendar and ensure that every sapling planted is monitored and nurtured to maturity.

2. Environmental Clean-ups & Waste Management

Contributing to SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities

We noticed that sporting events and community gatherings often leave behind a significant trail of waste, which degrades local ecosystems and diminishes community pride. Our goal is to instill a culture of stewardship where "leaving it better than we found it" becomes the standard mindset for every player and spectator. We achieve this by collaborating with waste management partners and community groups to organize regular clean-up drives and implement sustainable waste disposal systems at our events, transforming our players into active agents of environmental responsibility who carry these habits back into their own neighborhoods.

3. Nature & Animal Welfare

Contributing to SDG 15: Life on Land

We observed that true compassion is holistic and that there is often a disconnect between community development and the welfare of the animals that share our environment. Our goal is to bridge this gap by promoting responsible co-existence and kindness toward all living beings, recognizing that empathy learned through animal welfare translates into better human interactions. We are addressing this by partnering with animal shelters and welfare organizations fitting our goals to support rescue efforts and education, using our platform to advocate for the humane treatment of animals as a core component of building a conscientious and compassionate society.

Support This Project

item.title: Social
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Social Impacts

Jenga365 is committed to using rugby as a vehicle for social change. Our initiatives are designed to foster inclusion, provide access to education, and build leadership skills among the youth.

By aligning our efforts with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), specifically SDG 3 (Good Health & Well-being), SDG 4 (Quality Education), and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals), we ensure that every tackle on the pitch translates to a step forward for our community off the pitch.

Welfare

Get Involved

  • Donate Resources: We accept both monetary and non-monetary resources all year-round.

  • Volunteer: Join us for our next clinic or drive.

1. Education & Livelihoods: Back to School Drives

Contributing to SDG 4: Quality Education

We noticed a recurring challenge where talented young athletes often face barriers in the classroom simply due to a lack of basic resources like stationery, uniforms, and proper footwear. To ensure that material lack never stands in the way of a child’s education, we aim to create a consistent support system where academic readiness is treated with the same importance as match-day readiness. We are achieving this by building a scalable collection model that mobilizes the wider sporting community to donate essential items, turning tournaments into "collection hubs" through partnerships with organizations that align with our mission, thereby creating a sustainable circular economy of giving.

2. Mentorship Clinics & Fun Days

Contributing to SDG 3: Good Health & Well-being

While physical training is abundant, we identified a significant gap in mental resilience and off-pitch career guidance, often resulting in a disconnect between aspiring youth and the established senior players they look up to. Our goal is to bridge this generational gap and promote holistic well-being by fostering environments where mental health and life skills are passed down as naturally as ball-handling skills. We achieve this by facilitating interactive clinics and "Fun Days" in collaboration with established clubs and entities fitting our goals, a model that allows us to scale our reach and ensure that organic bonding and long-term mentorship pairs are formed consistently across different regions.

3. Youth Empowerment & Age-Grade Rugby

Contributing to SDG 17: Partnerships for the Goals

We observed that in many underserved communities, young people lack safe, structured spaces to develop critical life skills, leaving them vulnerable to social vices. To address this, we aim to use age-grade rugby not just as a sport, but as a vehicle for teaching discipline, teamwork, and leadership, creating safe zones where youth can develop the character traits necessary to succeed in adulthood. We achieve scalability and sustainability by actively seeking partnerships with community-based organizations that share our vision, allowing us to pool resources and standardize our approach to mentorship to build a pipeline of well-rounded individuals empowered to lead.

Support This Project

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Building Growth. Connecting Futures.

Bridging the gap between potential and performance through mentorship, networking, and sustainable action.

Transform Lives with Your Support! Donate Now

welcome to

Jenga365

More Than A Game: The Jenga365 Initiative

Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to transcend the traditional boundaries of sport. We exist to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by leveraging the discipline and community of rugby as a vehicle for holistic growth.

We recognize that an athlete’s journey involves more than just physical performance. That is why we bridge the gap between potential (youth) and performance (career and life) through a tripartite model:

  • Mentorship Programs (Human Capital): Connecting ambitious talent with seasoned professionals to build mental resilience and identity.

  • Networking Clinics (Social Capital): bridging the skills gap through financial literacy, career readiness, and professional access.

  • Impact Activities (Sustainability): Operationalizing "Rugby for Change" to drive environmental stewardship and climate action directly through the rugby calendar.

We are not just building players; we are building the "Total Athlete", addressing the Mind, Body, Pocket, and Planet.

Our Mission

To bridge the gap between potential and performance by keeping youth in the rugby community and extensive societies constructive 365 days a year. Jenga365 aims to create sustainable environments and enhance community welfare through a tripartite approach: specialized mentorship programs, career-focused networking clinics, and community-driven impact activities.

Our Foundation

Founded on the principle that an athlete's value extends far beyond the pitch, Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to build the "Total Athlete". We aim to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by bridging the gap between potential and performance. Whether you are an aspiring player seeking career readiness, a professional looking to give back, or an enthusiast passionate about the Green Game, Jenga365 provides the mentorship, networking, and impact activities needed to ensure no one navigates their journey alone.

Our Approach

We have evolved beyond simple matching. Jenga365 operates on a tripartite model designed to build the "Total Athlete".

  • Mentorship Programs: Building Human Capital through psycho-social support and career guidance.

  • Networking Clinics: Building Social Capital through financial literacy and professional access.

  • Impact Activities: Driving Sustainability through "The Green Game" and community stewardship.

This structured approach ensures that every connection drives not just personal success, but tangible community welfare.

Our Mission

To bridge the gap between potential and performance by keeping youth in the rugby community and extensive societies constructive 365 days a year. Jenga365 aims to create sustainable environments and enhance community welfare through a tripartite approach: specialized mentorship programs, career-focused networking clinics, and community-driven impact activities.

What We Do

The Tripartite Model

1. Building Human Capital (Mentorship Programs) At our core, Jenga365 bridges the gap between potential and performance. Our digital platform utilizes a tailored matching system to pair mentees with mentors who align with their specific goals, whether that is mental resilience, identity formation, or corporate advancement. We provide a structured, safe environment for knowledge transfer, ensuring every athlete builds the "Total Athlete" mindset.

2. Building Social Capital (Networking & Development Clinics) Rugby is our vehicle for social mobility. Through "Networking Clinics" and sports development sessions, we bridge the skills gap by connecting young athletes with senior professionals and corporate partners. These events go beyond skills and drills; they foster career readiness, financial literacy, and organic skills transfer, ensuring our athletes are as competitive in the boardroom as they are on the pitch.

3. Stewardship (Impact Activities) We believe in "Rugby for Change", integrating environmental stewardship directly into the rugby calendar. Our impact initiatives drive sustainable environments and quality community welfare, ensuring young people have the resources to realize the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 

Our Story

Jenga365 was born out of a desire to create lasting structures of support within the rugby ecosystem. Following a strategic restructuring in 2025, we have evolved from a passion project into a dual-engine development initiative. We have moved beyond simple engagement to building a functional, sustainable program that prioritizes Consistency and Growth. Today, we are laser-focused on the "Total Athlete", bridging the gap between potential and performance while driving tangible social and environmental impact.

Why Jenga365

    • Accessible Growth: We believe the "Total Athlete" should not be a luxury. Our mentorship and networking platforms are free and open to all, removing the barriers between talent and opportunity.

    • Values in Action: We take the core rugby values: Integrity, Passion, Solidarity, Discipline, Respect—and apply them beyond the pitch to drive Climate Action and Community Welfare.

    • Tangible Impact: We move beyond awareness to action. Every mentorship session and every "Rugby for Change" activity contributes directly to creating sustainable environments and realizing the UN SDGs.

    Join us in 2026. Let's build consistency, growth, and impact together.

Our history

From Connection to Impact: The Jenga365 Journey

History

The Genesis

Every structure needs a cornerstone. For Jenga365, that stone was laid in October 2024. We started with a singular, burning observation: there was a disconnect between talent and opportunity. We saw young people, particularly those in the rugby fraternity, who possessed immense potential but lacked the professional networks and mentorship guidance to navigate their futures. Our mandate back then was simple yet critical: bridge the gap. We launched as a platform dedicated solely to solving the issues of networking and mentorship, helping young talent find their footing.

1st October 2024

The Strategic Pivot

However, as we executed our initial pilots, we realized that true development requires more than just advice; it requires a holistic ecosystem. In 2025, we made a bold decision. We took a strategic break. We didn't just pause; we analyzed. relying heavily on Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) frameworks, we scrutinized every activity held since our inception. The data told us that while mentorship was vital, our community needed tangible support to thrive. We re-strategized. We expanded our scope: We moved beyond just conversation to include Impact Activities; initiatives like school drives and sports clinics that address immediate needs. We went digital: We launched an active, centralized website to streamline the matching process. We got holistic: We revamped our social media to reflect the full 360-degree view of an athlete’s life; education, sport, career, and community.

August 2025

The Acceleration

Today, in 2026, the foundation is settled, and the building has begun in earnest. We represent a new era of aggressive growth. We are no longer just "testing the waters." We are operating with set quarterly goals, driven by rigorous M&E to ensure that every resource deployed maximizes impact for the beneficiaries. But "Jenga" means "to build," and no great structure is built alone. As we scale our mentorship programs and deepen our community impact, we are actively opening our doors for collaboration. We are looking for like-minded organizations, corporate partners, and rugby clubs to join us. Our goal is not just to succeed as an organization, but to build each other up. Together, we can ensure that every young person we touch gets the start they deserve. Let’s Build. Let’s Connect. Let’s Impact.

2026 Onwards

NGO Registration

Registration as an NGO is ongoing, but the full operations are ongoing, and updates shared on the website and our socials.

Reminder

What Our Community Says

“Jenga365 connected me with a mentor who helped me transition from rugby to a thriving career in sports management.”

Jane Doe Mentee

“Mentoring through Jenga365 has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career.”

John Doe Mentor

More Than A Game: The Jenga365 Initiative<\/b><\/p>

Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to transcend the traditional boundaries of sport. We exist to create sustainable environments<\/b> and quality community welfare<\/b> by leveraging the discipline and community of rugby as a vehicle for holistic growth.<\/p>

We recognize that an athlete\u2019s journey involves more than just physical performance. That is why we bridge the gap between potential<\/b> (youth) and performance<\/b> (career and life) through a tripartite model:<\/p>

  • Mentorship Programs (Human Capital):<\/b> Connecting ambitious talent with seasoned professionals to build mental resilience and identity.<\/p><\/li>

  • Networking Clinics (Social Capital):<\/b> bridging the skills gap through financial literacy, career readiness, and professional access.<\/p><\/li>

  • Impact Activities (Sustainability):<\/b> Operationalizing \"Rugby for Change\" to drive environmental stewardship and climate action directly through the rugby calendar.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

      The Tripartite Model<\/b><\/h3>

      1. Building Human Capital (Mentorship Programs)<\/b> At our core, Jenga365 bridges the gap between potential and performance. Our digital platform utilizes a tailored matching system to pair mentees with mentors who align with their specific goals, whether that is mental resilience, identity formation, or corporate advancement. We provide a structured, safe environment for knowledge transfer, ensuring every athlete builds the \"Total Athlete\" mindset.<\/p>

      2. Building Social Capital (Networking & Development Clinics)<\/b> Rugby is our vehicle for social mobility. Through \"Networking Clinics\" and sports development sessions, we bridge the skills gap by connecting young athletes with senior professionals and corporate partners. These events go beyond skills and drills; they foster career readiness, financial literacy, and organic skills transfer, ensuring our athletes are as competitive in the boardroom as they are on the pitch.<\/p>

      3. Stewardship (Impact Activities)<\/b> We believe in \"Rugby for Change\", integrating environmental stewardship directly into the rugby calendar. Our impact initiatives drive sustainable environments<\/b> and quality community welfare<\/b>, ensuring young people have the resources to realize the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).\u00a0<\/p>","_id":"9eb42dd"},{"acc_title":"Our Story","acc_content":"

      Jenga365 was born out of a desire to create lasting structures of support within the rugby ecosystem. Following a strategic restructuring in 2025, we have evolved from a passion project into a dual-engine development initiative<\/b>. We have moved beyond simple engagement to building a functional, sustainable program that prioritizes Consistency and Growth<\/b>. Today, we are laser-focused on the \"Total Athlete\", bridging the gap between potential and performance while driving tangible social and environmental impact.<\/p>","_id":"3f10728"},{"_id":"11411da","acc_title":"Why Jenga365","acc_content":"

        • Values in Action:<\/b> We take the core rugby values: Integrity, Passion, Solidarity, Discipline, Respect\u2014and apply them beyond the pitch to drive Climate Action<\/b> and Community Welfare<\/b>.<\/p><\/li>

        • Tangible Impact:<\/b> We move beyond awareness to action. Every mentorship session and every \"Rugby for Change\" activity contributes directly to creating sustainable environments<\/b> and realizing the UN SDGs.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

Genesis","ekit_icon_box_description_text":"Every structure needs a cornerstone. Building Growth. Connecting Futures.

Bridging the gap between potential and performance through mentorship, networking, and sustainable action.

Transform Lives with Your Support! Donate Now

welcome to

Jenga365

More Than A Game: The Jenga365 Initiative

Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to transcend the traditional boundaries of sport. We exist to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by leveraging the discipline and community of rugby as a vehicle for holistic growth.

We recognize that an athlete’s journey involves more than just physical performance. That is why we bridge the gap between potential (youth) and performance (career and life) through a tripartite model:

  • Mentorship Programs (Human Capital): Connecting ambitious talent with seasoned professionals to build mental resilience and identity.

  • Networking Clinics (Social Capital): bridging the skills gap through financial literacy, career readiness, and professional access.

  • Impact Activities (Sustainability): Operationalizing "Rugby for Change" to drive environmental stewardship and climate action directly through the rugby calendar.

We are not just building players; we are building the "Total Athlete", addressing the Mind, Body, Pocket, and Planet.

Our Mission

To bridge the gap between potential and performance by keeping youth in the rugby community and extensive societies constructive 365 days a year. Jenga365 aims to create sustainable environments and enhance community welfare through a tripartite approach: specialized mentorship programs, career-focused networking clinics, and community-driven impact activities.

Our Foundation

Founded on the principle that an athlete's value extends far beyond the pitch, Jenga365 is a dual-engine development initiative designed to build the "Total Athlete". We aim to create sustainable environments and quality community welfare by bridging the gap between potential and performance. Whether you are an aspiring player seeking career readiness, a professional looking to give back, or an enthusiast passionate about the Green Game, Jenga365 provides the mentorship, networking, and impact activities needed to ensure no one navigates their journey alone.

Our Approach

We have evolved beyond simple matching. Jenga365 operates on a tripartite model designed to build the "Total Athlete".

  • Mentorship Programs: Building Human Capital through psycho-social support and career guidance.

  • Networking Clinics: Building Social Capital through financial literacy and professional access.

  • Impact Activities: Driving Sustainability through "The Green Game" and community stewardship.

This structured approach ensures that every connection drives not just personal success, but tangible community welfare.

[elementor-element k="b6eeef290c6ac05ba1f80d23855e19f2" data=""]
Our Mission

To bridge the gap between potential and performance by keeping youth in the rugby community and extensive societies constructive 365 days a year. Jenga365 aims to create sustainable environments and enhance community welfare through a tripartite approach: specialized mentorship programs, career-focused networking clinics, and community-driven impact activities.

What We Do

The Tripartite Model

1. Building Human Capital (Mentorship Programs) At our core, Jenga365 bridges the gap between potential and performance. Our digital platform utilizes a tailored matching system to pair mentees with mentors who align with their specific goals, whether that is mental resilience, identity formation, or corporate advancement. We provide a structured, safe environment for knowledge transfer, ensuring every athlete builds the "Total Athlete" mindset.

2. Building Social Capital (Networking & Development Clinics) Rugby is our vehicle for social mobility. Through "Networking Clinics" and sports development sessions, we bridge the skills gap by connecting young athletes with senior professionals and corporate partners. These events go beyond skills and drills; they foster career readiness, financial literacy, and organic skills transfer, ensuring our athletes are as competitive in the boardroom as they are on the pitch.

3. Stewardship (Impact Activities) We believe in "Rugby for Change", integrating environmental stewardship directly into the rugby calendar. Our impact initiatives drive sustainable environments and quality community welfare, ensuring young people have the resources to realize the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 

Our Story

Jenga365 was born out of a desire to create lasting structures of support within the rugby ecosystem. Following a strategic restructuring in 2025, we have evolved from a passion project into a dual-engine development initiative. We have moved beyond simple engagement to building a functional, sustainable program that prioritizes Consistency and Growth. Today, we are laser-focused on the "Total Athlete", bridging the gap between potential and performance while driving tangible social and environmental impact.

Why Jenga365

    • Accessible Growth: We believe the "Total Athlete" should not be a luxury. Our mentorship and networking platforms are free and open to all, removing the barriers between talent and opportunity.

    • Values in Action: We take the core rugby values: Integrity, Passion, Solidarity, Discipline, Respect—and apply them beyond the pitch to drive Climate Action and Community Welfare.

    • Tangible Impact: We move beyond awareness to action. Every mentorship session and every "Rugby for Change" activity contributes directly to creating sustainable environments and realizing the UN SDGs.

    Join us in 2026. Let's build consistency, growth, and impact together.

Our history

From Connection to Impact: The Jenga365 Journey

History

The Genesis

Every structure needs a cornerstone. For Jenga365, that stone was laid in October 2024. We started with a singular, burning observation: there was a disconnect between talent and opportunity. We saw young people, particularly those in the rugby fraternity, who possessed immense potential but lacked the professional networks and mentorship guidance to navigate their futures. Our mandate back then was simple yet critical: bridge the gap. We launched as a platform dedicated solely to solving the issues of networking and mentorship, helping young talent find their footing.

1st October 2024

The Strategic Pivot

However, as we executed our initial pilots, we realized that true development requires more than just advice; it requires a holistic ecosystem. In 2025, we made a bold decision. We took a strategic break. We didn't just pause; we analyzed. relying heavily on Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) frameworks, we scrutinized every activity held since our inception. The data told us that while mentorship was vital, our community needed tangible support to thrive. We re-strategized. We expanded our scope: We moved beyond just conversation to include Impact Activities; initiatives like school drives and sports clinics that address immediate needs. We went digital: We launched an active, centralized website to streamline the matching process. We got holistic: We revamped our social media to reflect the full 360-degree view of an athlete’s life; education, sport, career, and community.

August 2025

The Acceleration

Today, in 2026, the foundation is settled, and the building has begun in earnest. We represent a new era of aggressive growth. We are no longer just "testing the waters." We are operating with set quarterly goals, driven by rigorous M&E to ensure that every resource deployed maximizes impact for the beneficiaries. But "Jenga" means "to build," and no great structure is built alone. As we scale our mentorship programs and deepen our community impact, we are actively opening our doors for collaboration. We are looking for like-minded organizations, corporate partners, and rugby clubs to join us. Our goal is not just to succeed as an organization, but to build each other up. Together, we can ensure that every young person we touch gets the start they deserve. Let’s Build. Let’s Connect. Let’s Impact.

2026 Onwards

NGO Registration

Registration as an NGO is ongoing, but the full operations are ongoing, and updates shared on the website and our socials.

Reminder

What Our Community Says

item.title: Impact
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Community Engagement

'Rugby for a Better Tomorrow'

At Jenga365, we believe that rugby’s true power lies not only in what happens on the pitch but in the lasting impact it can create off it. Our goal is to harness the core values of the game, teamwork, discipline, and resilience, to make a tangible difference in people’s lives and communities.

To achieve this, we have structured our efforts into two primary community engagement pillars, Social Impact and Environmental Impact. These initiatives are strategically designed to align with key UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), ensuring that every project we undertake contributes to a more equitable society and a sustainable future.

Through our impact initiatives, we aim to:

Equip rugby players with the tools, mentorship, and networks to thrive beyond the game.
Create sustainable pathways for social and environmental change.
Build a community that lifts others as it climbs.

Our impact is structured in two categories:

Social Impact

We support causes that uplift vulnerable populations and empower the next generation. Our players and mentors give back by volunteering, procuring resources, and offering guidance to those who need it most. Education & Livelihoods: Through initiatives like "Back to School Drives," we procure stationery, uniforms, and non-monetary donations to ensure students start their academic year with dignity and readiness. Visiting ophanages and animal shelters are also part of projects we will undertake under this umbrella. Mentorship Clinics: In partnership with organizations like AISA and Nondies Cubs, we facilitate fun days and clinics where senior players connect with youth talent, fostering organic mentorships that transcend sport.

Learn more

Environmental Impacts

We recognise that a thriving game needs a thriving planet. Our "Green Game" initiatives focus on environmental stewardship to ensure we leave the pitch, and the planet, better than we found it. Reforestation/Afforestation: Engaging the rugby community in tree-planting exercises. Clean-ups: Community environmental clean-up drives.

Learn more
Together, these impacts ensure that rugby in Kenya is more than just a sports, it’s a movement for growth, purpose, and legacy.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: j365
item.content:encoded:
Table of Contents

  • 1. Information We Collect
  • 2. How We Use Your Information
  • 3. How We Share Your Information
  • 4. Your Privacy Rights
  • 5. Security and Data Storage
  • 6. Children's Privacy
  • 7. International Data Transfers
  • 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
  • 9. Contact Us
  • 10. Frequently Asked Questions

Privacy Policy for Jenga365

Last Updated: September 24, 2025

Jenga365.com ("we," "us," or "our") is a mentoring platform connecting individuals in sports and careers, based in Nairobi, Kenya. We prioritize your privacy, handling sensitive sports and career data transparently. By using our platform, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect only the data necessary for mentoring, event management, and platform improvement.

Personal Information You Provide

  • Registration and Profile: Name, email, phone, profile photo, sports background (e.g., discipline, achievements), career details (e.g., resume, goals).
  • Events: Webinar or clinic registration and attendance data.
  • Communications: Contact forms, emails, social media interactions.

Sensitive Information

Collected with explicit consent:

  • Sports Metrics: Training logs, injury history, performance goals.
  • Career Preferences: Detailed career goals for matching.

Automatically Collected Data

  • Technical Data: IP address, device, browser, operating system.
  • Browsing Activity: Pages visited, links clicked, content viewed, timestamps.
  • Social Integrations: Data from Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram via social login, per your privacy settings.

Cookies

We use cookies for analytics and functionality:

  • Necessary (Session): Enable core features, authentication.
  • Functionality (Persistent): Save login details, preferences.
  • Analytics (Persistent): Track usage to improve the platform.

Manage cookies via browser settings or our Cookies Policy.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your data (per GDPR/CCPA legal bases) to:

  • Provide Services: Create accounts, match mentors/mentees, manage events, deliver content.
  • Personalize: Recommend content, improve functionality.
  • Communicate: Send notifications, marketing emails (with consent).
  • Social Features: Enable sharing, social logins (e.g., LinkedIn).
  • Security: Prevent fraud, ensure safety.
3. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell data. We share it only when:

  • Matched Users: Profile/contact details with mentors/mentees, with consent.
  • Service Providers: Vendors (e.g., AWS, Zoom, Mailchimp) under strict agreements.
  • Business Transfers: During mergers, with notice.
  • Legal Requirements: For compliance or to protect rights/safety.
  • With Consent: For other purposes with permission.
4. Your Privacy Rights

Under GDPR, CCPA, and Kenya’s Data Protection Act, 2019, you can:

  • Access: Request your data.
  • Rectify: Correct inaccurate data.
  • Delete: Request deletion, subject to legal retention.
  • Object: Opt out of marketing or processing.
  • Portability: Receive data in a machine-readable format.
  • Opt-Out of Sale: We don’t sell data, but you can opt out of future sales.

Email privacy@jenga365.com or use your dashboard. We respond within 30 days after verification.

5. Security and Data Storage

We protect your data with:

  • HTTPS: Encrypts transmission.
  • Access Controls: Limits internal access.
  • End-to-End Encryption: Planned for mentoring chats.
  • Audits: Regular security checks.

Retention: Data kept only as needed, purged within 60 days of deletion.

Breach Notification: We notify within 72 hours of a breach (per GDPR).

6. Children's Privacy

Jenga365 is for users 16+. Youth programs require parental consent for under-16s. We don’t collect data from under-13s. Contact privacy@jenga365.com for issues.

7. International Data Transfers

Data may transfer globally (e.g., U.S. to EU). We use Standard Contractual Clauses for GDPR compliance.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this policy, notifying you via:

  • Email.
  • Banner on jenga365.com.
  • Updates at jenga365.com/privacy-policy.

Continued use indicates acceptance.

9. Contact Us

Contact our Privacy Team:

  • Email: privacy@jenga365.com
  • Website: jenga365.com/contact-2/

File complaints with Kenya’s Office of the Data Protection Commissioner.

10. Frequently Asked Questions

How is my data handled in mentoring sessions?

Sessions are confidential. Chats will use end-to-end encryption (when implemented). Third-party platforms (e.g., Zoom) follow their privacy policies.

Are my resume or metrics public?

No, sensitive data is shared only with matched mentors/mentees, with consent.

Why use social media data?

For login and sharing features (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter), limited by your privacy settings.

Cookies Policy

We use cookies to enhance your experience. Manage preferences via browser settings or our consent tool. See Free Privacy Policy.

Back to Top

item.title: Jenga365 Partners with The Try Again Project for a Community Touch Rugby Tournament at Lower Kabete Rehabilitation School
item.dc:creator: project_lead
item.content:encoded:
On Saturday, 29th November, Jenga365 was honored to receive an invitation from The Try Again Project to participate in their community-based Touch Rugby Tournament hosted at Lower Kabete Rehabilitation School.

The event brought together teams from multiple age groups, each competing in a friendly round-robin format designed to promote teamwork, fun, and inclusivity.

This tournament was more than just a series of games, it was a celebration of hope, mentorship, and the role sport can play in shaping character and creating opportunities.

The Try Again Project has long been committed to using rugby as a tool for rehabilitation and personal development among the youth at Lower Kabete Rehabilitation School. The tournament provided the participants with:

  • A chance to express themselves through sport
  • A competitive yet supportive environment
  • An opportunity to connect with teammates and mentors
  • A reminder that they have a community rooting for them

For many of the participants, events like this are a rare moment of joy, confidence-building, and emotional release, and Jenga365 was grateful to be part of it.

As part of our Impact Program, the Jenga365 team came prepared with non-monetary donations, contributing items that support wellbeing, training, and day-to-day needs at the institution.

We aim to make such contributions consistent, sustainable, and scalable as we deepen our community footprint.

This event also gave us a renewed understanding of the importance of creating safe spaces where young people can engage positively, learn, and grow, a core value embedded in the Jenga365 mentorship philosophy.

The highlight of the day came from watching teams across various age grades take the pitch; smiling, competing, learning, and encouraging each other.

The games were structured in a round-robin fashion, ensuring that:

  • Every team had equal playing time
  • Players interacted with peers of similar experience levels
  • The focus remained on learning and growth rather than winning

This format captured the essence of what community rugby is all about: connection, resilience, and collective joy.

At Jenga365, we believe that rugby is a powerful tool for transformation, and meaningful collaborations strengthen that impact.

We are open to partnering with:

  • Community-Based Organizations (CBOs)
  • Social enterprises
  • Foundations and NGOs
  • Corporate CSR programs

Together, we can deliver initiatives such as:

  • Community rugby clinics
  • Mentorship and life skills workshops
  • Tree planting and environmental drives
  • Orphanage visits and donation campaigns
  • Clean-up and rehabilitation projects

The Try Again Project has set an incredible example of what such partnerships can achieve, and we look forward to continuing the journey with them and many others.

This event served as an important milestone for Jenga365 as we expand our social impact programming alongside our core pillars of mentorship, networking, and career development for Kenyan rugby players.

Our vision is clear:

Use rugby to build people. Use people to build communities. Use communities to build a better future.

We extend our deepest appreciation to:

  • The Try Again Project
  • The Lower Kabete Rehabilitation School
  • The volunteer coaches and organizers
  • Every player who took part

Your efforts and energy made this day meaningful.

If your organization, club, or CSR department is interested in collaborating with Jenga365, we would love to connect.

Email: info@jenga365.com

Website: www.jenga365.com

Instagram/X/LinkedIn: @Jenga365

item.title: Why Jenga365 Matters And Why It’s a Game Changer for RugbyKE and Beyond
item.dc:creator: project_lead
item.content:encoded:
Rugby in Kenya has always been more than a sport. It’s a culture, a family, and a place where character is forged. Yet for many players, the journey outside the pitch has been unclear, marked by limited mentorship, scattered opportunities, and very few structured avenues to grow both personally and professionally. This is where Jenga365 steps in. Jenga365 was built with a simple but powerful vision: to help rugby players thrive in life, not just in the game. Through mentorship, networking, and community impact, the platform is offering what the ecosystem has long needed structure, guidance, and connection. 1. Because mentorship is no longer optional, it is essential. Many players navigate rugby with big dreams but limited guidance. Whether it’s balancing school and training, transitioning into employment, or planning for retirement from the sport, support is often inconsistent. Jenga365 changes this by connecting players directly with mentors who understand the journey, coaches, former players, professionals, and industry leaders. These mentors offer: Career direction Personal development guidance Life skills coaching Exposure to new opportunities The ripple effect is powerful: players make better decisions, avoid burnout, and build a future beyond rugby. 2. Because players need access to networks, not just talent. Talent opens doors, but networks keep them open. Rugby players in Kenya often struggle to meet people who can support their careers, businesses, or academic paths. Through webinars, targeted networking sessions, and structured interactions, Jenga365 creates a space where: Players connect with employers Alumni reconnect with the current generation Professionals share opportunities Fans and supporters contribute their expertise It is a bridge, one that finally connects the rugby pitch to the wider world. 3. Because the RugbyKE community can do more together. A sport becomes stronger when its people uplift each other. Jenga365 is championing this through impact programs that go beyond rugby: Tree planting and environmental cleanups Orphanage and shelter support Animal welfare assistance Community service projects School outreach and mentorship clinics These activities remind players that rugby is not just about winning matches, it’s about building character, empathy, and responsibility. This is how sport transforms society. 4. Because structure brings sustainability. For years, many great rugby initiatives have struggled because they lacked systems, no tracking, no follow-up, no continuity. Jenga365 is changing this narrative by establishing: Consistent webinars Set mentorship cycles Clear community engagement plans Tracking systems to measure progress and impact Annual calendars for all programs This structure ensures that the vision outlives individuals, seasons, and clubs. It ensures that the impact compounds. 5. Because every player deserves a chance, all 365 days of the year. Not just on match days. Not just in-season. Not just when they win. Jenga365 is committed to walking with players through:
  • Transition seasons
  • Injuries
  • Academic pressure
  • Job searches
  • Career changes
  • Personal struggles
  • Retirement
This year-round support system is what makes Jenga365 a game changer. It’s more than a program, it’s a community that grows with you. The Future of #RugbyKE Starts With Investment in People Jenga365 matters because it shifts the focus from short-term performance to long-term growth. It reminds us that players are not just athletes, they are students, professionals, leaders, parents, innovators, and community builders. By supporting them holistically, we strengthen clubs, improve the national pipeline, and uplift the entire rugby ecosystem. And as Jenga365 expands its partnerships, impact programs, and mentorship initiatives, one thing becomes clear: When players grow, the game grows. And when the game grows, the community grows. That is why Jenga365 is here. And that is why it matters, today, tomorrow, and for generations to come.

item.title: Reflections from the AISA Back to School 7s
item.dc:creator: project_lead
item.content:encoded:
Showing Up and Giving Back

Our primary mission for the day was to deliver the contributions raised during our recent Back to School Drive. Thanks to the generosity of the Jenga365 community, we were able to support the initiative with resources collected prior to the event. Seeing the donations go directly to the beneficiaries reminded us that small, consistent acts of kindness can collectively create a massive impact.

The Concept of "Social Networth"

Between the matches, the sidelines offered a perfect venue for dialogue. We spent the day engaging with players and other stakeholders, not just about rugby tactics but also about life strategy.

A key theme of our conversations was "Social Net Worth". We emphasised to the young players that while their physical fitness is important, the network they build today, their social capital, is what will sustain them tomorrow. Mentorship is the bridge that connects their current talent to future opportunities, and Jenga365 is here to help build that bridge.

A Surprise on the Touchline

On a personal level, the day took an exciting turn when I was asked to step in as a coach for the Nondies Academy.

Transitioning from spectator to coach was an exhilarating experience. Guiding the young talents, managing their energy, and helping them structure their play gave me a front-row seat to the potential that lies within our age-grade structures. It was a practical reminder of why mentorship matters, sometimes all a young person needs is a calm voice on the sideline believing in them.

Looking Ahead: Scaling Up

We extend our deepest gratitude to the Afri-Impact Sports Academy (AISA) for organising such a purposeful tournament and for inviting us to be part of the fold.

As we reflect on the success of the weekend, our eyes are set firmly on the future. 2026 is our year of consistency. We are committed to refining our delivery, improving our logistics, and scaling up our impact. We want to ensure that engagements like this aren't one-off events but part of a sustained rhythm of development.

Thank you to everyone who contributed to the drive and everyone who stopped by to say hello. Let’s keep building.

Jenga365. Building Growth. Connecting Futures.
item.excerpt:encoded:
"Rugby is a game of inches," they say, but at Jenga365, we believe it’s also a game of connections.
This past weekend, we had the distinct privilege of participating in the AISA Back to School 7s, an event that perfectly captured the intersection of sport, community, and development. For us, it wasn't just another tournament; it was a checkpoint in our 2026 mission of consistency and growth.

item.title: The Ultimate Cheat Code: Why 'Sports for Change' is the Future of Player Welfare and Community/Environmental Impact
item.dc:creator: project_lead
item.content:encoded:
For decades, the conversation around sports has been linear: you play, you compete, you win or lose, and eventually, you retire. But at Jenga365, we view the game differently. We see "Sports for Change" not just as a slogan, but as a strategic accelerator, a unique mechanism that, when supported, radically improves player welfare and transforms communities faster than traditional methods ever could.

Here is why our approach is the game-changer we have been waiting for.

1. The "Social Networth" Advantage

The biggest crisis facing athletes today is the "Final Whistle" dilemma: what happens when the career ends? The traditional route to career success relies on formal education and cold networking. The Sports for Change approach serves as a cheat code because it bypasses the cold introduction.

When a CEO stands on a touchline watching a match, or when a senior professional engages in a mentorship clinic, the barrier to entry is lowered. Through our mentorship initiatives, we convert the camaraderie of the pitch into "social net worth". We teach our players that the person passing them the ball today could be the person hiring them tomorrow. By integrating professional mentorship directly into the rugby ecosystem, we ensure players are building their CVs alongside their tackle counts.

2. Accelerating Life Skills (The Classroom Without Walls)

Teaching discipline, resilience, and teamwork in a classroom can take years. On a rugby pitch, it takes 80 minutes. Rugby demands that you get up immediately after being knocked down. It demands that you trust the person next to you implicitly. These are the exact soft skills that employers are desperate for in the modern marketplace.

Jenga365’s "cheat code" is simply formalizing this transfer of skills. Through our mentorship clinics and webinars, we help athletes translate their on-field resilience into off-field career durability. We are turning athletes into highly employable leaders, not by changing who they are, but by helping them apply what they already know to a new context.

3. Mobilizing for Community Impact

Why is sports such a powerful tool for social good? Because it commands attention. Trying to rally a community to buy books for a school can be a logistical nightmare. But participating in a "Back to School 7s" tournament? That pulls a crowd.

Our approach leverages the passion of the fan base to drive social impact. Initiatives like our Back to School Drives alongside our esteemed partners like AISA work because they tap into the collective spirit of the rugby fraternity. We turn spectators into donors and players into changemakers. It is a multiplier effect, where a single tournament can educate a child, and a single try can protect the environment.

4. The Green Game: A Cheat Code for the Planet

Environmental conservation often feels abstract and distant to young people. We bridge that gap by making it tangible and competitive. Through initiatives like "Trees for Tries" alongside AISA, we align environmental stewardship with athletic performance. When a player knows that their success on the pitch directly contributes to reforestation, they become personally invested in the ecosystem. This isn't just Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR); it is "Athlete Social Responsibility". We are creating a generation of defenders, not just of their try-line, but of their environment.

The 2026 Vision: Consistency as the Key

A cheat code only works if you enter it correctly every time. As Jenga365 moves into 2026, our focus is on Consistency and Growth. We are proving that Sports for Change isn't a one-off charity event; it is a sustainable, scalable model for development.

By supporting this initiative, partners aren't just sponsoring a team; they are investing in a high-yield system that produces educated youth, employed professionals, resilient communities, and a greener planet.

The game has changed. It’s time to play with the advantage.

Join the Movement. Whether you are a mentor, a corporate partner, or a player, there is a place for you in the Jenga365 scrum. Let’s build the future together.
item.excerpt:encoded: In the world of gaming, a "cheat code" isn't about breaking the rules; it’s about unlocking a hidden advantage that allows you to navigate difficult levels with speed and precision. In the world of social/environmental development and youth empowerment, Jenga365 believes that Sports: Rugby is that cheat code.
